topic: My dog waiting for me at the window
title: At the Window
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Every evening when I turn the key,
there's a nose against the glass for me,
a tail that's going faster than the clock,
he's been waiting since I left at eight o'clock.

[Chorus]
At the window, at the window,
he waiting window for me is always being,
at the window, at the window,
the one face I know I'll be seeing.

[Verse 2]
He doesn't care how bad my day has been,
he doesn't ask me where or why or when,
he only knows the sound of my old car,
and that's enough to make me who we are.

[Chorus]
At the window, at the window,
he waiting window for me is always being,
at the window, at the window,
the one face I know I'll be seeing.
reason: Good song except one chorus line that is ungrammatical word salad ('he waiting window for me is always being'), sung in every chorus.
